title: OVERLAY_PHASE_PROFILE_BATCH_NO_Y
purpose: Generate one B/C-grade batch of overlay colour-phase profile candidates from the already hash-verified SLICE-004 overlay_pixel_readback tables. No mask, image, mesh, slice or performance-y access is permitted.

candidate_schema.RAW-X036: 25 direct scalar statistics from red, blue, purple and union pixel-count profiles across 800 overlay pairs
candidate_schema.RAW-X037: 3 normalised mean colour-phase fractions from the same non-zero-union overlay-pair population
candidate_schema.normalization: red_pixel_count/union_pixel_count, blue_pixel_count/union_pixel_count, purple_pixel_count/union_pixel_count; denominator must be positive and is never imputed

next_step_if_pass: PRM-105 XREG-v0.5 consolidation and block audit only; no active-roster change
